title: Clean up resources owned by an InputFile subclass
goal: Release a derived file-input component's cancellable status subscription when it leaves the rendered UI, preserving InputFile's own callback cleanup and normal file selection.

runtime.reason: The primary route uses .NET 11 ASP.NET Core framework contracts/analyzers.
runtime.name: .NET

platforms: ASP.NET Core server and JavaScript-enabled browser; measured Windows x64/Chromium. No native toolchain required.
constraints: Override Dispose(bool), guard managed cleanup with disposing, and always call base.Dispose(disposing). Do not replace the explicit IDisposable entry point.
The .NET 10 comparison composes an InputFile inside a disposable owner; its renderer independently disposes the child.
Cancellation unsubscribes future status notifications. It neither reverses completed reads/uploads nor joins a callback already copied by the publisher.
Only Interactive Server component removal and bounded file reading are executed; no remote upload/storage, removed stream-option migration, WebAssembly, trimming/AOT or actual-GA guarantee.
